section: Fixes and new things
roadmap: Launcher: skip an update; test builds that are ahead of a release are not "updated" backwards
---
- Launcher: the update window has "Skip this version". A skipped version is
  never shown or installed by itself again; a newer one is offered as usual.
  What's New, Versions and Settings can still install it or stop skipping.
- Launcher: the start-up setting is now called "Automatic updates" (still on
  by default), and it never installs a version you skipped.
- Launcher: on a test build that already has everything in a new release,
  you see "You already have everything in vX (your test build is newer)"
  instead of an update. When that can't be told, it asks instead of
  installing by itself.
